s.d: The eighth numeral symbol of the English alphabet, called aitch and written in the Latin script.
Abbreviation of hour, particularly when used as a (non-SI) unit of time alongside International System of Units (SI) units.
s.e: Another instance: 2ʰ28ᵐ p. m., 10 micra; 3ʰ08ᵐ p. m., 0 micra; irrigated with water: 3ʰ09ᵐ p. m., 4 micra.
